name: DOI Field
project_description:
This module provides a Doi type field. 

 Add a "DOI Field" to your content

 Choose the display options for the field

 Add the DOI to the field

 When displayed the field will show the selected info for that DOI

 You can configure the display of the field to show the selected elements of the corresponding publication

 Furter Developments 

 Depending on the module demand a cache alternative to avoid requests to the API everytime you see the node might be implemented.

 Requirements 

 This module requires the DOI Publications Search

 https://www.drupal.org/project/doi_search wich is automatically installed when using composer
